reasoning: On the season so far the Rockets are the stronger team; with home court the Rockets start about 10 points better, in a game of about 222 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Pacers.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Rockets win 75 times in 100, by about 9; most games like this end between 196 and 244 total points.
